standard.summary: EMA loss 至少下降这么多才算“仍在变好”。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The EMA loss has to fall at least this much to count as still improving.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: EMA loss 至少下降这么多才算“仍在变好”。默认偏保守，避免微小波动长期锁住余弦。

advanced_en.principle: The EMA loss must drop at least this much to count as "still improving". The default is conservative, keeping tiny fluctuations from locking the cosine for a long time.
